media:group.media:description:
Vintage in Pills VALENTINO Fall 2003 Paris - Fashion Channel
Valentino’s collection combines ladylike tailoring with elaborate embellishment and references to 1940s and Edwardian fashion. Hourglass jackets, pleated skirts and cocktail dresses feature intricate details, including mink sleeve appliqués, padded satin decorations and bead embroidery inspired by antique jewellery.
Ivory lace and chiffon blouses are paired with black skirts, while textured knitwear and layered accessories introduce a bohemian influence. Eveningwear takes centre stage in flowing gowns decorated with dragonfly embroidery, alongside a lilac flapper-inspired dress covered in bugle beads. The collection brings together refined silhouettes, rich materials and ornate craftsmanship.

media:group.media:title: MAISON MARGIELA Spring 2027 Best Looks Paris - Fashion Channel
media:group.media:description:
MAISON MARGIELA Spring 2027 Best Looks Paris - Fashion Channel
Glenn Martens explores the contrasting elements of Maison Margiela’s design language through a collection that combines classic tailoring with experimental fabric treatments. Floral brocades appear in column skirts, while signature jackets feature folded lapels and sculptural front constructions.
Trench coats, grey T-shirts and draped jersey dresses are reworked with stiff interfacing inserts, creating contrasts between soft fabrics and structured shapes. Checked shirts and tailored trousers continue the house’s approach to everyday dressing, while a red lace slip laminated with vinyl is layered beneath a pink satin coat. Eveningwear introduces sculptural draping, metallic embellishment and flowing capes, bringing a more elaborate dimension to the collection.
